piezas.titulo: Word reading: Persuasion and rhetorical devices
texto: Reading and spelling of rhetorical and classical oratory terms: «โน้มน้าว» has two front vowels, โ and แ, with the mark ้ over น in both syllables, both sounding at high tone with a deliberate vowel rhyme (nóom-náao). «จุดยืน» has «จุด» (low tone, with the mid-class consonant จ and ด in the แม่กด group) and «ยืน» (mid tone with the vowel อือ). «น้ำหนัก» has «น้ำ» (high tone with the mark ้) and «หนัก» (low tone, with the cluster หน as a substitute for หนำ). «ข้อคัดค้าน» has «ข้อ» (falling tone), «คัด» (high tone, with the low-class consonant ค and ด in the แม่กด group) and «ค้าน» (high tone with the mark ้ over ค).
